name: Memory Consolidation Gate
description: agent-memory operating contract: v4. Consolidate durable knowledge and solution progress after every agent turn.

then.prompt: Review what happened in this session. Store durable What and Where facts with agent-memory write. Account for What, Where, and When; use literal N/A with a concise reason for an optional dimension with no applicable stored value. If a solution episode is active, append a final agent-memory work step, checkpoint if continuation is needed, and transition it to the truthful terminal status. If the result is verified and reusable, run agent-memory work promote. Always run agent-memory session-end --transcript "<one paragraph summary>" --format json. Do not store private chain-of-thought; store only concise rationale summaries.
